tweets.text:
There's a difference between waiting and being ready. Most people can manage the first one, sit still and let days pass without forcing anything.

The second part is harder. It means staying alert enough that when the setup actually shows up, you still recognize it and still have the energy left to act on it.

A lot of missed opportunities didn't come from impatience. They came from patience that quietly turned into looking without actually seeing anything.
